verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's on-device execution keeps prompts, audio, and images on the device and works offline without an account, which in practice keeps that data out of any training pipeline. Hosted execution is explicit, so data leaves only when the user chooses, and a community reply states no data is collected locally. However, nothing addresses whether data sent to Wally Cloud may be used for model training, and there is no training opt-out or data-use policy. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out control for Wally Cloud requests, and documented data-retention/usage terms with independent verification.
